task.description:
WF-03 Step 01 (Diagnose) for ISS-0040. Perform root-cause diagnosis for failing XC-02..XC-06 integration suites and produce an actionable fix map for Step 02.

Mandatory outputs:
1. Categorize each failing cluster using WF-03 categories (A/B/C/D/E/F).
2. Identify concrete root cause per requirement cluster (XC-02, XC-03, XC-04, XC-05, XC-06).
3. Provide files_to_change and whether each issue is blocker.
4. Confirm whether fixes can stay within Step-02 size constraint (<=5 source files) or require escalation/design correction.
5. Register/refresh issue record(s) for traceability before completing handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Diagnosis covers all XC-02..XC-06 failure clusters
Each cluster has category, root cause, and files_to_change
A clear go/no-go decision for Step 02 fix execution is provided
Handoff result status is PASS unless blocked by ambiguity/conflict

result.summary: WF-03 Step 01 diagnosis completed for XC-02..XC-06. Root causes are mixed: XC-03 is CATEGORY B (integration/schema mismatch and incomplete XC-03 path), while XC-02/XC-04/XC-05/XC-06 are CATEGORY E (test-code drift against current schema/runtime behavior). Step 02 cannot proceed in one iteration under the <=5-file cap.

issues.description: CATEGORY E. Root cause: test expectation and fixture-order drift (expects UnexpectedRow vs ServerError, insertion-order assumptions under timestamp+UUID ordering, and inline UUID allocation leaks). files_to_change=[tests/integration/xc02_audit_immutability_test.zig].

CATEGORY B. Root cause: repository integration/schema mismatch in current migration state plus incomplete XC-03 source path. files_to_change=[migrations/052_xc03_configuration_repository.sql, src/config/loader.zig, src/repository/artifacts.zig, tests/integration/xc03_configuration_repository_test.zig].
CATEGORY E. Root cause: test SQL does not match current event/timer schema contract (column and relation assumptions). files_to_change=[tests/integration/xc04_kernel_determinism_test.zig].
CATEGORY E. Root cause: replay tests use schema assumptions that fail before replay assertions execute. files_to_change=[tests/integration/xc05_deterministic_replay_test.zig].

CATEGORY E. Root cause: backwards-compat tests depend on legacy table/column and ordering assumptions not aligned with current schema state. files_to_change=[tests/integration/xc06_backwards_compatibility_test.zig].
Step 02 cannot proceed in a single WF-03 iteration because minimum combined fix scope is >=6 files (exceeds <=5-file cap).

result.next_action: Escalate to ORCH to split fixes into multiple WF-03 rework handoffs, then route first split to ISSUE-FIXER Step 02.
